arithmetic_reflections.scope: Every distinct unit square for N=15,21,35; every reflection center; all caps through min(d,64); and the complete hidden-root fibre used only for offline outer-decoding counts.

generic_matching.scope: Every odd d<=9, every odd fixed count q, every absorbing size b=q+2g, every singleton start, and every perfect matching of the remaining ranks. All comparisons use Fraction arithmetic.

generic_reflection.scope: Generic F(i)=-i mod d for five odd primes. This is not an F326 arithmetic counterexample.

sparse_pool.scope: All deletion orders through pool size seven, plus eight seeded full uniform-pop runs at every size through 31.
